'''Bixi magaca Cutubka/Ururka Mawduuca la soo jeediyay'''

Kani wuxuu noqon doonaa magaca lagu diiwaangelinayo hay'ad sharci ah marka la ansixiyo.
contactpage-affcom-chapter-thorg-applica:
'''Bixi URL xiriirinta bogga-hoosaadka codsiga ururkaaga ee Meta-Wiki'''

Kani waa bogga aad ku abuurtay tallaabada 1 ee habka tilmaamaha abuurista Cutubka/Ururka Mawduuca
contactpage-affcom-chapter-thorg-bylaws-:
'''Bixi URL xiriirinta Xeer-hoosaadyada ururkaaga ee Meta-Wiki'''

Dib-u-eegista xeer-hoosaadyadu waa tallaabada koowaad ee aqoonsiga Cutub/Urur Mawduuc, waana in la dhammaystiraa ka hor inta aan la samayn wax kasta oo ka dhigi kara ururka mid rasmi ah, sida furashada akoon bangi, qabashada shir aasaasi ah, ama ka diiwaangelinta hay'adaha dalkaaga. Wakiil ka socda AffCom ayaa kula soo xiriiri doona wixii su'aalo, talooyin ama sixitaanno ah.
contactpage-affcom-chapter-thorg-self-as:
'''Liiska Hubinta Is qiimeynta'''

Hubi in qaybaha soo socda lagu daray xeer hoosaadyada
contactpage-affcom-chapter-thorg-rules-l:
'''Xeerarka Cutubka/Ururka Mawduuca'''

Markaad gudbiso codsigan, waxaad xaqiijinaysaa in ururkaagu buuxiyo shuruudaha soo socda sida lagu faahfaahiyay tilmaamaha abuurista Cutubka/Ururka Mawduuca:

- Himilo taageerta Wikimedia

- Diirad juqraafiyeed/mowduuc

- Qaab dhismeed sharciyeed (Xeer hoosaadyo)

- Tirada muhiimka ah ee ka-qaybgalka firfircoon ee wax-ku-darayaasha Wikimedia

- Ugu yaraan laba sano oo hawlo ah

- Awood, ama awood la qorsheeyay, oo lagu buuxin karo filashooyinka mustaqbalka
contactpage-affcom-chapter-thorg-terms-l: Waxaan akhriyey oo aan oggolahay xeerarka kor ku xusan iyo [[foundation:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Universal Code of Conduct|Xeerka Anshaxa Caalamiga ah]]
contactpage-stewards-disclaimer-label: Ogeysiis: Dhammaan macluumaadka aad ku darto foomkan waxaa loo gudbinayaa, laga shaqaynayaa, lagana jawaabayaa xubno mutadawiciin ah oo ka tirsan bulshada (gaar ahaan [[Special:MyLanguage/Stewards|Wakiilada]]), ee ma aha Wikimedia Foundation. Fadlan ha ku darin wax macluumaad ah oo aadan ku qanacsanayn in lala wadaago mutadawiciinta Wikimedia. Jawaabaha iyo waraaqaha kale ee la xiriira habaynta macluumaadka aad gudbisay looma tixgelinayo inay yihiin bayaano rasmi ah oo ka socda Wikimedia Foundation. Xiriir rasmi ah awgiis, fadlan kala xiriir Wikimedia Foundation hababka ku qoran https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/contact/.

contactpage-pagetext-accountvanishapps:
Baaba'a akoonka waa '''xalka ugu dambeeya''' waana in '''kaliya la isticmaalaa marka aad rabto inaad joojiso tafatirka weligaa''' iyo sidoo kale inaad qariso inta ugu badan ee xiriirradii hore ee aad lahayd. Baaba'a akoonka ee Wikipedia waxaa lagu sameeyaa iyadoo la beddelayo magaca akoonkaaga si dadka kale aysan u aqoonsan karin waxqabadkaaga, habkan waxaa loo yaqaan tirtiridda akoonka. '''Baaba'a akoonku ma dammaanad qaaddo qarsoodi buuxda mana ka saarto wax ku biirinnada mashaariicda.''' Si aad wax badan uga ogaato baaba'a akoonka, booqo bogga macluumaadka [[Special:MyLanguage/Right to vanish|Xaqa tirtiridda akoonka]].

Si aad u bilowdo habka baaba'a akoonka, fadlan buuxi foomka codsiga baaba'a Akoonka ee hoose.
contactpage-emailsenttext-accountvanisha: Codsigaaga baaba'a akoonka ayaa loo diray qiimeyn. Haddii aad qabto su'aalo ku saabsan codsigaaga wakhti kasta, waxaad la xiriiri kartaa {{NonSpamEmail|privacy|wikimedia.org}}.
contactpage-accountvanishapps-details: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan codsiga
contactpage-blocked-message-accountvanis: Waan ka xunnahay, waxay u muuqataa in akoonkaaga ama cinwaankaaga IP-ga hadda laga xannibay dirista farriimaha. Ma isticmaali kartid Foomka Tirtiridda Akoonka inta aad xanniban tahay. Si aad u sii waddo tirtiridda akoonka, fadlan u dir iimayl {{NonSpamEmail|privacy|wikimedia.org}}.
